name: RegularGrid
description: A rectilinear (aka uniform or regular) grid, for LevelSet shapes or other purposes. A cubic regular grid extending from a min<RegularGrid.min> = (m,m,m) to a max at (M,M,M), with nGP<RegularGrid.nGP> = (n,n,n) ie a spacing<RegularGrid.spacing> = (M-m)/(n-1), can be conveniently obtained from RegularGrid(m,M,n). For more general cases, minimum point min<RegularGrid.min>, spacing<RegularGrid.spacing> and nGP<RegularGrid.nGP> have to be passed as such at instantiation.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: The minimum corner of the grid.

attributes.name: nGP
attributes.description: The number of grid points along the three axes as a Vector3i.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: The (uniform and isotropic) grid spacing between two axis-consecutive grid points.

methods.name: gridPoint
methods.description: Returns the Vector3 position of any grid point, given its indices *i* (along the X-axis), *j* (Y-axis), *k* (Z-axis).

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum corner of the grid.

methods.name: dims
methods.description: Returns the grid dimensions along the three axes, as a Vector3.

methods.name: closestCorner
methods.description: Returns the Vector3i indices of the closest gridpoint which is smaller (for all components) than *pt*.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
